# Thanksgiving Hymns Column 17 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** 1QHa (Cave 1), Col. 17 | **Condition:** moderately damaged

---

**17:1** I thank You, Lord, for You have lit up my face with Your covenant,

**17:2** and from [...] I seek You, and as reliably as the dawn You come to me as pure, unclouded light.

**17:3** But those among Your people [...] led them off course, and peddlers of lies smoothed the road for them,

**17:4** so they stumble around without a clue. For [...] everything they do is driven by madness.

**17:5** I mean nothing to them; they hold me in contempt

**17:6** even when You display Your strength through me. They drove me out of my homeland

**17:7** the way someone flushes a bird from its nest, and every companion, every friend I had,

**17:8** has been driven far from me. They look at me like a shattered pot.

**17:9** These charlatans -- spinners of lies, visionaries of deception --

**17:10** they hatched a wicked plot against me, trying to swap out Your teaching, the one You carved on my heart,

**17:11** and replace it with easy words for Your people. They keep the drink of real knowledge from the parched

**17:12** and hand them vinegar instead, so they end up staring

**17:13** at their own delusions, going wild at their feasts, tangled in their own nets.

**17:14** But You, God, You reject every scheme Belial hatches,

**17:15** and Your plan alone stands firm, and the purpose of Your heart endures forever.

**17:16** They are hypocrites, spinning Belial's plots;

**17:17** they seek You with a split heart and have no grounding in Your truth.

**17:18** Their thoughts are rooted in poison and bitterness,

**17:19** and they roam around in stubborn self-will; they look for You among idols,

**17:20** propping up the stumbling block of their own sin right in front of their faces.

**17:21** They come seeking You through lying prophets who have seduced them into error.

**17:22** With stuttering lips and a foreign tongue

**17:23** they talk to Your people, turning all their efforts into a farce through deception.

**17:24** They never chose the path of Your heart, never listened to what You said;

**17:25** they declared about the vision of true knowledge: That is baseless! And about the way of Your heart: That is not it!

**17:26** But You, God, will answer them -- You will judge them by Your power

**17:27** according to their idol-worship and the sheer number of their crimes,

**17:28** and they will be caught in their own traps, these people who walked away from Your covenant.

**17:29** You will wipe out every deceiver in judgment, and the false visionaries will vanish for good.

**17:30** There is no foolishness in anything You do, no deception in the purpose of Your heart.

**17:31** Those who live as You desire will stand before You forever,

**17:32** and those who walk the path of Your heart will stand firm for all eternity.

**17:33** As for me, when I hold on to You, I rise -- I stand tall against the ones who despise me,

**17:34** and my hand strikes back at everyone who mocks me. They give me no credit

**17:35** even when You demonstrate Your power through me. You revealed Yourself to me in Your strength at the crack of dawn,

**17:36** and You did not let my face be covered in shame [...] those who seek You in the community council [...]

**17:37** [...] standing before You [...] forever.

---
*PNEUMA notes: Column 17 is one of the most personally anguished passages in the Hodayot -- a prophet cast out, slandered, abandoned by every friend, watching false teachers lead the people astray with seductive half-truths. This could be the Teacher of Righteousness himself speaking.*
